metaTitle: Flight Delayed With a Transfer Booked? What Happens Next
metaDescription: Your flight is late and your airport transfer is already booked. Here is how flight tracking, free waiting time and fixed pricing work, and what to do next.
excerpt: A delayed flight does not cost you your transfer. The chauffeur tracks your flight and the pickup moves with it, at no extra charge. Here is exactly what happens, what you need to do, and where things can go wrong.
quickAnswer: Nothing bad happens. Emirates Limo tracks your flight number, so when your plane lands late the pickup time moves with it and your chauffeur is in the arrivals hall when you walk out. The fare stays fixed at the price you paid, with no delay surcharge, and 60 minutes of free waiting time runs from the actual landing time. Just make sure the flight number on the booking is correct.
content:
If your flight is delayed, your transfer waits for you. Emirates Limo tracks every arriving flight by its flight number, so the pickup time shifts automatically when the plane lands late, and there is no extra charge for the delay. The chauffeur is in the arrivals hall with a name board when you come through, whether you land on time, an hour early or three hours late.

What happens to my transfer when my flight is delayed?

The pickup time moves to match the new landing time, and nothing else changes. The price you paid at booking is fixed, so a late arrival never turns into a bigger bill, and your 60 minutes of free waiting time starts counting from the moment the aircraft actually lands rather than the time it was scheduled to.

That works because the booking is tied to a flight number, not to a clock time. When the airline pushes the arrival back, the dispatch team sees the change on the same live data the airport publishes, so the chauffeur is sent to the terminal for the real arrival rather than the original one.

Is the flight tracked?Yes, by flight number, for every airport pickup

Do I need to call anyone if my flight is running late?

No, as long as the flight number on your booking is correct. The delay shows up on the airport's live feed and the pickup is adjusted without you doing anything, which is the whole point of booking a Dubai airport transfer that meets you in arrivals rather than a car that turns up at a fixed time.

The one time you should get in touch is when the flight itself changes. If the airline moves you onto a different flight, a later departure the same day or a completely new routing, the old flight number is no longer being tracked and the chauffeur will be waiting for a plane you are not on. Message or call +971 56 996 4924 with the new flight number as soon as you have it and the booking is updated.

Before you fly, here is what to have ready:

  • Your booking confirmation email, with the pickup date and flight number on it
  • The airline's flight status page bookmarked, such as the Emirates flight status tool if you are flying with them
  • The Emirates Limo WhatsApp number saved to your phone
  • A working phone once you land, so the chauffeur can reach you if the arrivals hall is busy

How does the chauffeur know when I have landed?

The same way you do: from the airport's live arrivals data. Dubai Airports publishes scheduled and actual times, terminal and status for every DXB flight, and the dispatch team watches that feed for your flight number from the moment it takes off. The chauffeur is dispatched so they are inside the arrivals hall, name board in hand, by the time you clear immigration and collect your bags.

Dubai Airports notes that there is no pick-up area at arrivals and drivers meeting passengers should use the terminal car park. That is why a name board pickup matters: the chauffeur parks, walks in to meet you, helps with the luggage and walks you back to the car, rather than circling outside hoping to spot you at the kerb.

Pickups at Zayed International (AUH) run the same way, with the flight tracked and 60 minutes of free waiting time. If you are landing in the capital, book an Abu Dhabi airport transfer and the chauffeur meets you inside the terminal there.

What if my flight is cancelled or I miss my connection?

A cancellation is different from a delay, because there is no longer a flight to track. Dubai Airports points out that the airline handles rebooking when a flight is delayed or cancelled, so your first call is to them. Once you know the new flight, send the number and the new date to Emirates Limo and the transfer is moved to match.

The cancellation policy is simple and has one tier. Cancel 24 hours or more before the pickup time and you get a full refund; cancel inside 24 hours, or do not show up, and the fare is charged in full. If a cancelled flight means you will not travel at all, tell us as early as you can so the booking can be cancelled while it is still refundable.

Where do airport pickups go wrong?

The wrong flight number is the number one cause. A digit out of place, or the outbound flight entered instead of the inbound one, means the wrong plane is tracked and the chauffeur is timed to the wrong arrival. Check the number on the confirmation email against your ticket before you fly.

Unreported flight changes come second. Airlines sometimes rebook passengers onto an earlier or later service without much notice, and the original booking still points to the old flight. Whenever your itinerary changes, the fix is a quick WhatsApp with the new details.

The third is the wrong terminal. DXB has three, and Emirates flights use Terminal 3 while most other carriers use Terminal 1 or 2, so if you are unsure, check the terminal on the airport's flight status page and make sure the booking has the right one. The same rules on waiting time, tracking and cancellation apply to a private chauffeur from Emirates Limo on any other journey too, and the full list is on the FAQ page.

ctaBlock:
Landing late? Your chauffeur will still be there

Emirates Limo tracks your flight, moves the pickup to the real landing time and gives you 60 minutes of free waiting at the airport, all at the fixed price you paid. Get an instant quote and book your Dubai airport transfer online, or message us on WhatsApp at +971 56 996 4924.

faqs.question: Will I be charged extra if my flight is delayed?
faqs.answer: No. The fare is fixed when you book and it does not change for a delay, traffic or a late landing. Your 60 minutes of free waiting time at the airport counts from the actual landing time, not the scheduled one.

faqs.question: Do I need to tell Emirates Limo my flight is late?
faqs.answer: Not for a delay on the same flight, because the flight number is tracked and the pickup moves automatically. You only need to get in touch if the airline moves you onto a different flight, in which case send the new flight number by WhatsApp to +971 56 996 4924.

faqs.question: What happens if my flight lands early?
faqs.answer: The pickup moves earlier to match. The chauffeur is dispatched against the live arrival time, so an early landing is handled the same way as a late one, and the 60 minutes of free waiting time still runs from the moment you land.

faqs.question: Can I get a refund if my flight is cancelled?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you cancel the transfer 24 hours or more before the pickup time. Inside 24 hours the fare is charged in full, so if you know you will not be travelling, cancel as early as possible. If you are rebooked onto a new flight, the transfer is simply moved to match it at no extra cost.
